design: One fresh-context agent, four complete analysis tasks, latest temporal skill only; reviewed by the parent after completion.
scope: Analytical trace and assumption review; no code execution or theorem prover.

P01.evidence: Infinite allowed receipt/restart cycle; durable Done not entailed.

P02.evidence: Finite restarts and subsequent successful local steps imply eventual Done; deduplication per ID, no clock deadline.

P03.evidence: Optional human wait and perpetual app allowed; Leave still closes preview.

P04.evidence: Third Pending resets remaining to two and schedules forbidden fourth poll.

limitations: Targeted development probe following a revealed shared limitation.
No baseline repeat; no causal superiority claim.
Does not validate a production implementation.
